correctness.rationale: The theorem quantifies only over n=3,4,5 for literal simplicial collapses and n=6 for the entire integral relative homology. The two independently coded membership oracles agree on every one of 2^(2n+1) subsets. Face counts for (Ind_1,Ind_2) including the empty face are (18,42),(47,103),(103,313),(254,866). Exact ordered free-face checks collapse Ind_2 to Ind_1 in 12,28,105 pairs for n<=5. For n=6, all 612 relative faces and 1647 relative Hasse incidences are enumerated; a fully acyclic 301-pair matching leaves 7,2,1 critical cells in dimensions 3,4,5. All matched pivots are units; exact integer elimination gives d4=[a a] with primitive a=(0,0,1,1,0,-1,0) and d5=(1,-1), hence H3=Z^6 and all other relative groups vanish. A second unreduced original-chain mod-two calculation independently confirms ranks 0,24,102,123,48,6 and relative Betti six in degree 3. Code and recorded output have been executed and checked. No inference for n>=7 is made.

originality.rationale: The conclusion is a statement about the inclusion Ind_1(mu(C_n)) -> Ind_2(mu(C_n)) as an actual simplicial collapse, and about a complete integral relative homology obstruction at the first subsequent length. Taylan studies graph devoid complexes and their matching methods but classifies paths, cycles and forests, not this Mycielskian family or its inclusion; Deshpande-Singh treats higher-independence for different graph classes. Goyal-Shukla-Singh and Carnero Bravo classify ordinary independence homotopy for Mycielskians, which does not determine the higher-independence inclusion or relative chains. The sphere type of the ordinary Grötzsch independence complex is explicitly credited to prior literature. Indexed near matches have distinct vertices/facet definitions and do not imply the present theorem. Residual nonindexed publication priority risk remains.
residual_risks: Unindexed, differently named or unpublished calculations of the same four relative pairs might exist; searches do not prove uniqueness.
Some indexed near matches were available only as title and short summary; no whole-document noncoverage is inferred from those summaries.
The current theorem does not classify Ind_2(mu(C_n)) for n>=7 or the absolute homotopy type at n=6.

scientific_integrity.claim_boundary: Only n=3,4,5 and n=6 as explicitly stated; no higher-n extrapolation, and K_5 sphere is known ordinary background.

value.rationale: The canonical inclusion Ind_1(G) -> Ind_2(G) asks whether admitting induced isolated edges changes the topology, not merely face counts. Mycielskian cycle graphs are a canonical graph family with a well-understood ordinary-independence baseline. Genuine elementary collapses at exactly n=3,4,5 and a nonzero primitive, torsion-free rank-six relative homology group at n=6 give the first proven transition in this ordered family. This is an interpretable structural boundary for the natural map and a reproducible test case for extensions, not a renamed textbook inference or an arbitrarily chosen unmotivated invariant.
